variants.headline: The {{building}} opens in {{city}}
body: Work on {{city}}'s {{building}} is complete. Residents watched the builders remove their final scaffolds, then gathered at the entrance as the keeper unlocked the doors. The new building is now in service.

variants.headline: Notice from {{city}}: the {{building}} opens
body: We are informed that work on the {{building}} in {{city}} is finished, and its doors will open at first light. The keeper asks visitors to arrive before dusk. Those attending to business there may now make their arrangements.

variants.headline: The {{building}} opens, and the neighbors peek in
body: The {{building}} is complete in {{city}}, and the last ladder came down at sunrise. Mrs. Vale brought her grandson to watch the workers sweep the steps; he asked if they could come back tomorrow. They will have no work here, but the doors are ready.

variants.headline: Another job for the builders of {{city}}
body: {{city}} has its {{building}}, and the men who raised it are already asking what comes next. The foreman has kept his best hands on the payroll, a cost the city pays every quiet week. If the {{terms.civic.government}} has another site in mind, this is the season to break ground.

variants.headline: {{city}} puts money behind the {{building}}
body: The city has put money into the {{building}} at {{city}}, and work has picked up. Extra carts have arrived at the site while crews keep two shifts on the scaffold. Nearby shopkeepers say the building work starts earlier and runs later.

variants.headline: City funds for the {{building}}
body: Word from {{city}} says that a new payment has been assigned to the {{building}}, and the workmen are to be paid through winter. The stewards will display the accounts at the site each week. Material suppliers should inquire at the site.

variants.headline: The price of haste in {{city}}
body: {{city}} has put money into its {{building}}, and the work has quickened. More hands now crowd the scaffold, while the keeper talks of an opening day. The faster schedule comes at a cost: the city chest is lighter, and another project must wait.

variants.headline: News of the {{building}}
body: Hear me, {{terms.civic.people}}! New funds have arrived for the {{building}} in {{city}}! We will not wait for tomorrow when we can lead today. Speed the work! Speed the work!

variants.headline: {{building}} completed in {{city}} via {{currency}}
body: The {{terms.civic.government}} has used {{currency}} to quickly secure the construction of a {{building}} in {{city}}. The building is now fully operational.

variants.headline: No wait in {{city}}: the {{building}} is bought
body: Other cities wait seasons for a {{building}} and watch every course go up. {{city}} did it in an afternoon: counted out {{currency}}, took the keys, opened the door. The masons who expected the work are still standing in the yard.

variants.headline: To the merchants and citizens of {{city}}
body: It is our pleasure to announce that a {{building}} has been secured for {{city}} via a generous investment of {{currency}}. Such foresight by the {{terms.civic.government}} ensures our continued prosperity and growth.

variants.headline: {{city}} pays for speed
body: {{city}} bought its {{building}} outright for {{currency}}, and the work was finished before anyone could watch it rise. Speed was the purchase, and the price is entered in the city books. What the same sum might have done elsewhere is not written down, which is how most bargains escape judgment.

variants.headline: New defenses completed in {{city}}
body: The {{building}} in {{city}} is complete. Local commanders state that the new structure significantly improves the city's ability to withstand an attack.

variants.headline: {{city}} Bolsters National Defense
body: The completion of the {{building}} in {{city}} marks a critical advancement in our national defense strategy. By strengthening this hub, the {{terms.civic.government}} has ensured that {{city}} remains an impregnable fortress. The {{building}} serves to safeguard the unity and longevity of our great people.

variants.headline: Fortification in {{city}}
body: Hear me, {{terms.civic.people}} of {{city}}! The {{building}} is finished! Our walls are stronger and the nation is safer. A stronger {{city}}, a safer {{terms.civilization}}!

variants.headline: Fortification at {{city}}
body: We are pleased to relate that the {{building}} in {{city}} is now operational. Through the foresight of the {{terms.civic.government}}, our city stands as a formidable bastion against any who would threaten us.

variants.headline: Courthouse opens in {{city}}
body: The {{building}} in {{city}} is now complete. The new facility will serve as the center for local administration and legal proceedings, ending a period of military occupation.

variants.headline: {{city}} takes its place in the realm
body: We have governed {{city}} as a conquered city. With the {{building}} in service, it can now be administered on the same footing as our other cities.
